name: Beeri
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: The word of the Lord came unto Hosea the son of Beeri in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

note.label: Hosea 1: A Wife of Whoredoms and the Sand of the Sea

points: “The word of the Lord that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.” During the times of these kings, the kings we read about earlier, Hosea is prophesying against the northern kingdom.

note.label: Gentiles: What Happened to Northern Kingdom?
